title: Finite bit construction: twelve R439 helper shears save 94 ADDs
body:
PR1047 leaves multi-shear extensions open. This finite bit-circuit construction composes twelve additional restored helper shears on its frozen word, reducing **11,769 to 11,675 complete ADDs**. All preparation and restoration gates are paid; forward/reverse positive bounds remain **72,847 / 10,394,084**, and the paid rank profile stays unchanged. **No new kappa, best-known-count claim or physical supplier admission.**

The seed 15 bounded run completes 2,499,666 ordered-pair scores in 13 rounds and 416 full trial invoices. Twelve steps are admitted. The thirteenth round stops because all first 32 positive nominees fail precision, while 836 positive-score pairs remain; this is not an optimum or impossibility claim. The selected shears commute, and no noncommutative advantage is claimed.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/r439-helper-descent-seed15/verify.py
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_R439_HELPER_DESCENT ADDs=11769->11675 rounds=12 columns=661 no_new_kappa
```

Packed columns and explicit sets agree on all scores. A separate literal row constructor and retained set-valued interpreter verify every trial on all 661 dirty-input columns, both orientations, COPY/ERASE lifetimes and complete prices. Final geometry, frame paths, paid rank mass 5,129, nine source pins, ten rejection controls and a charged neutral pair pass. Normal CPython 3.14.8 and optimized isolated 3.11.15 agree, including an outside-checkout invocation. Fourteen relevant existing tests pass. Exact gates, SHA256/Git-blob pins, proof, coverage and open next questions are in the six-file package.

Base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Immediate predecessor PR1047: `a01bd602969e4086e55f0d1f392855b91cfe0507`; PR967: `c6caa79e6655d83780a3b70a1d658313126fb0b3`. Source packages and selected frontier are untouched. The syntactic H2 and literal K_equals_D failures are inherited; exact semantic D equality passes. Native/whole-hosted adoption, full invoices, cold replay and inherited compiler/hosting/analytic obligations remain open.

The final overlap check covered 865 open PRs and 44 discussion threads plus recent comments. PR1122/1188/1208 already report cheaper circuits in other classes; this adds a separately reproducible 94-ADD composition on PR1047 and does not combine their counts. No pinned sprint issue existed; the local claim records the scope and result.

Credit woklerx/PR1047, Sricharan Vagvala/PR967, Gareth Davidson/PR915/926, Ross Richardson/PR965, Sagar Thakrar/PR753, DreamingOfClouds/PR589, eumemic/PR555/543 and the retained semantic-D/basis-change lineage. Prepared for Sagar Thakrar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human review is claimed.
